images.filename: Brick building on 1308 E Street, New Whatcom, Washington, ca 1895 (WASTATE 822).jpeg
images.caption:
Built in 1858 by the firm of T.G. Richards and Co. In 1863 sold to the Whatcom County to be used as a courthouse. New Whatcom was later incorporated into the town of Bellingham in 1903. Signs on building read: James F. Cass, U.S. Commissioner, Land Office.  Western Union Telegraph Office.
On verso of image: Old Whatcom Court House said to be the first brick building in Washington Territory.
Subjects (LCSH): Building, brick--Washington (State)--Bellingham; United States. General Land Office
